reserveReview.rationale: Re-opened 2026-08-29: Ondo's current Global Markets trust-and-transparency documentation states that tokenized stocks and ETFs are fully backed by the underlying security plus cash in transit, with daily holdings verification by Ankura Trust and custody at one or more US-registered broker-dealers. SLVon is the tokenized iShares Silver Trust (SLV) exposure. The reviewed Ondo API documentation says current price feeds are display-only and that an official oracle is still in development; no Chainlink or Chronicle NAV configuration is present for SLVon in the Pharos registry, and no current dated SLVon holdings report was retrieved from the public product page. The reserve remains one fund-share envelope because SLV shares versus cash-in-transit weights are undisclosed.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ondo SLVon product, trust and transparency, and oracle guidance
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: Independently re-fetched public Ankura-verified consolidated Ondo Stocks daily and monthly report folders on 2026-10-02. The latest daily report is September 29 and the latest monthly report is August; neither discloses a SLVon-specific allocation between SLV shares, cash in transit, or other eligible collateral, nor SLVon-specific custodial provider shares. SLVon Final Terms identify the intended underlying security and permit other collateral, but do not supply dated holdings or weights. The aggregate reserve basket remains 100% unresolved.
